_meta.notes: Sōtō Zen reached Peru with Japanese immigration; Taiheizan Jionji (1907) is the oldest Zen temple in Latin America. The Comunidad Budista Sōtō Zenshū del Perú is the Sōtōshū-affiliated body.

places.name: Templo Ryūzan Zuihōji
places.lineage: Sōtō (Comunidad Budista Sōtō Zenshū del Perú)
places.address: Julián Arias Aragüez 652, San Antonio, Miraflores, Lima 15047, Peru
places.notes: The official Sōtōshū directory confirms the Miraflores address and the Peruvian community’s site describes zazen, ceremonies, and other temple activities. Contact the temple for the current program.

places.name: Templo Taiheizan Jionji
places.address: Calle Almirante Grau 697, San Vicente de Cañete, Lima 15701, Peru
places.notes: The official Sōtōshū directory confirms the Cañete address. The temple’s page describes intensive zazen, baika classes, and ceremonies; contact it for current dates.

places.name: Espacio de Práctica Zen Cusco
places.lineage: Sōtō (Comunidad Budista Sōtō Zenshū del Perú)
places.notes: The official Peruvian Sōtō community identifies a Cusco practice space founded in 2012. A current detailed schedule and venue are not published; contact the community before attending.
